reviewSamples.author: Photo of George Hopper
reviewSamples.text: Our yard was in fair shape at best when we switched over to APL Lawn Spraying.  Rick and his crew has brought our lawn to grade A+ condition.  Rick has offered his knowledge to help maintain our lawn.  I highly recommend this company!  Great job guys!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Jack
reviewSamples.text: I am only in my second month with APL Lawn Spraying.  Rick seems very knowledgeable and he is certainly very personable.  The worker bee that came and did the work was likewise.  Time and the continuing condition of my lawn will tell and provide a more definitive description of their service.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of David Nguyen
reviewSamples.text: I am glad I found APL Lawn Spraying having bad experiences with some other lawn services previously. APL has been taking care of my yard for almost 2 yrs now and it always look great. The owner is very professional and informative. Overall, excellent services, timely and effective communication.
